notes: The two supplied *that*s go to the infinitives under rule 85 rather than to ἀπεκρίθη.

The μὲν οὖν assignment is the one genuinely open call: the ASV writes one word for the adjacent pair, so rule 70 empties one of them; *Howbeit* is taken as the adversative answering the μέν … δέ correlation, and giving it to οὖν instead remains defensible.
